description: Agent runtime composition root for Agentic OS
pre_install: Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'https://github.com/coilyco/agentic-os/releases/download/aos-v0.434.0/aoscompose-windows-amd64.exe' -OutFile "$dir/aoscompose-windows-amd64.exe"; if ((Get-FileHash "$dir/aoscompose-windows-amd64.exe" -Algorithm SHA256).Hash -ne '910f6815e1a17e33cee98ab900493bb5c37803f8511317c4811a9e111b952adc') { throw 'aoscompose checksum mismatch' }

Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'https://github.com/coilyco/agentic-os/releases/download/aos-v0.434.0/aosward-windows-amd64.exe' -OutFile "$dir/aosward-windows-amd64.exe"; if ((Get-FileHash "$dir/aosward-windows-amd64.exe" -Algorithm SHA256).Hash -ne '910f6815e1a17e33cee98ab900493bb5c37803f8511317c4811a9e111b952adc') { throw 'aosward checksum mismatch' }

Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'https://github.com/coilyco/agentic-os/releases/download/aos-v0.434.0/aosguard-windows-amd64.exe' -OutFile "$dir/aosguard-windows-amd64.exe"; if ((Get-FileHash "$dir/aosguard-windows-amd64.exe" -Algorithm SHA256).Hash -ne 'b10018b401312fa650052d827d25f6c444ae5dd43444298b31a22aefd341045c') { throw 'aosguard checksum mismatch' }
